title: Keynote
summary: Copilot moves from assistant to 'autopilot': agents with their own identity work alongside people, the core platform gets faster, domain experts build their own solutions, and governance and cost management are consolidated in the admin centers.
whyItMatters: Sets the direction for the whole platform: Copilot becomes an active participant in work, and governance and cost management are built into the admin experience.

keyPoints.heading: Copilot to Autopilot
keyPoints.text: Copilot can be embedded in Teams as its own user/account and act on work items.

keyPoints.heading: Performance
keyPoints.text: Many performance improvements to the existing platform, not just new features.

keyPoints.heading: Domain experts first
keyPoints.text: Enable people who hold the domain knowledge to build their own solutions; Work IQ powers makers inside Power Platform Copilot.

keyPoints.heading: Canvas apps
keyPoints.text: Pop-out formulas, Dataverse-optimized, responsive out of the box.

keyPoints.heading: Apps in Copilot
keyPoints.text: Build apps inside Copilot, share them, reuse Power Platform connections, access from Copilot Studio; code apps.

keyPoints.heading: Copilot Studio harness
keyPoints.text: New harness and UI: 48% less token input, 20% better outcomes; more token efficient across task types.

keyPoints.heading: Agents
keyPoints.text: Fully natural language, auto model selection, scheduled triggers, memory of previous runs, own mailbox/identity/OneDrive; can be emailed, chatted with, @mentioned, pulled into meetings, and comment in documents.

keyPoints.heading: No cliffs between no code and low code
keyPoints.text: Agents write the code; Power Automate flows (JSON definitions) can be explained, updated, and diagnosed with GitHub Copilot in VS Code.

keyPoints.heading: Copilot Managed Runtime
keyPoints.text: Fully managed platform with governance controls covering DLP, oversight, and security.

keyPoints.heading: Governance in admin center
keyPoints.text: Agents overview / agent map, connector settings, Copilot cost management; Power Platform advisory plugin in Cowork answers governance questions in natural language.

anthony: GCC: need to know when we get access to the new harness.
Takeaway: understand customers' domain knowledge before the app spec.

openQuestions: How do AI credits get configured?
